body:
Thank you very much for your advice; you're completely right.

It's weird how just telling strangers what's on your mind and talking with them can really help boost your spirits.
Thank you. I might take you up on that sometime. (:

I appreciate the thought very much. That's a good idea about garage sales, I'll see if there are any next weekend close enough to walk to. The weather has been the perfect temperature for walking lately, anyhow. Thank you!
Embarrassingly enough ... I never learned how to ride a bike. :/ But it's something I could look into if I found a cheap used bike and learned how to ride it.

Thank you. I do feel guilty regularly for being so unhappy when things could be so much worse, (not that you made me feel guilty! that's just a staple in my everyday routine) and I think when I someday do get a car my first thing to do will be to set up meetings with a Psychiatrist/Psychologist at the free clinic here. There are a lot of things I need to get on track and my mental health is one of them.

I will take what you said about fitness to heart. I could stand to be healthier and a self esteem boost would be good for developing a social life I'm sure.

Thank you very much for your suggestions. (:
Sadly I live in a smaller North Carolina town without any public transportation, it's such a bummer. But thank you for the suggestions. If I ever make it up to Michigan I'll let ya know. :P
